properties.description: ADF pipeline for post-migration validation. Compares source and target tables across multiple dimensions: row count, null counts per column, duplicate checks, and data type verification. Produces a structured JSON validation report.

activities.name: LookupSourceRowCount
activities.description: Get total row count from the source table for comparison.

oracleReaderQuery.value: @if(equals(pipeline().parameters.sourceType, 'Oracle'), concat('SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM ', pipeline().parameters.sourceSchema, '.', pipeline().parameters.sourceTable), '')

sqlReaderQuery.value: @if(equals(pipeline().parameters.sourceType, 'SQLServer'), concat('SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM [', pipeline().parameters.sourceSchema, '].[', pipeline().parameters.sourceTable, ']'), '')

activities.name: LookupTargetRowCount
activities.description: Get total row count from the target Azure SQL table for comparison.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM [', pipeline().parameters.targetSchema, '].[', pipeline().parameters.targetTable, ']')

activities.name: LookupSourceNullCounts
activities.description: Get null counts per column from the source table. Uses dynamic SQL to generate SUM(CASE WHEN col IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) for each column.

activities.name: LookupTargetNullCounts
activities.description: Get null counts per column from the target Azure SQL table.

activities.name: LookupTargetDuplicateCheck
activities.description: Check for duplicate rows in the target table based on the specified key columns.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT COUNT(*) AS DUPLICATE_GROUPS, ISNULL(SUM(DUP_COUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_DUPLICATE_ROWS FROM (SELECT ', pipeline().parameters.duplicateCheckColumns, ', COUNT(*) AS DUP_COUNT FROM [', pipeline().parameters.targetSchema, '].[', pipeline().parameters.targetTable, '] GROUP BY ', pipeline().parameters.duplicateCheckColumns, ' HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS dups')

activities.name: LookupTargetDataTypes
activities.description: Retrieve column data types from the target Azure SQL table for data type validation.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = ''', pipeline().parameters.targetSchema, ''' AND TABLE_NAME = ''', pipeline().parameters.targetTable, ''' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION')

activities.name: SetValidationResult
activities.description: Build a comprehensive validation result JSON comparing all source vs target metrics.

value.value: @concat('{', '"pipelineRunId": "', pipeline().RunId, '",', '"validationTimestamp": "', utcNow(), '",', '"sourceType": "', pipeline().parameters.sourceType, '",', '"sourceTable": "', pipeline().parameters.sourceSchema, '.', pipeline().parameters.sourceTable, '",', '"targetTable": "', pipeline().parameters.targetSchema, '.', pipeline().parameters.targetTable, '",', '"checks": {', '"rowCount": {', '"sourceRowCount": ', string(activity('LookupSourceRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT), ',', '"targetRowCount": ', string(activity('LookupTargetRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT), ',', '"difference": ', string(sub(int(activity('LookupSourceRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT), int(activity('LookupTargetRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT))), ',', '"passed": ', if(equals(int(activity('LookupSourceRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT), int(activity('LookupTargetRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT)), 'true', 'false'), '},', '"nullCount": {', '"sourceNulls": ', string(activity('LookupSourceNullCounts').output.firstRow), ',', '"targetNulls": ', string(activity('LookupTargetNullCounts').output.firstRow), ',', '"passed": ', if(equals(string(activity('LookupSourceNullCounts').output.firstRow), string(activity('LookupTargetNullCounts').output.firstRow)), 'true', 'false'), '},', '"duplicateCheck": {', '"duplicateGroups": ', string(activity('LookupTargetDuplicateCheck').output.firstRow.DUPLICATE_GROUPS), ',', '"totalDuplicateRows": ', string(activity('LookupTargetDuplicateCheck').output.firstRow.TOTAL_DUPLICATE_ROWS), ',', '"passed": ', if(equals(int(activity('LookupTargetDuplicateCheck').output.firstRow.DUPLICATE_GROUPS), 0), 'true', 'false'), '},', '"datatypeCheck": {', '"targetColumnCount": ', string(activity('LookupTargetDataTypes').output.count), ',', '"columns": ', string(activity('LookupTargetDataTypes').output.value), '}', '},', '"overallPassed": ', if(and(and(equals(int(activity('LookupSourceRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT), int(activity('LookupTargetRowCount').output.firstRow.ROW_COUNT)), equals(string(activity('LookupSourceNullCounts').output.firstRow), string(activity('LookupTargetNullCounts').output.firstRow))), equals(int(activity('LookupTargetDuplicateCheck').output.firstRow.DUPLICATE_GROUPS), 0)), 'true', 'false'), '}')

nullCheckExpression.defaultValue: SUM(CASE WHEN col1 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS col1_nulls
